name: TestFontNotoNaskhArabic

source.verification: Byte copy of ofl/notonaskharabic/NotoNaskhArabic[wght].ttf (stored as NotoNaskhArabic-wght.ttf: repository paths do not allow brackets) and OFL.txt at google/fonts commit 06bfe0d62a98375cb09c942fa18e68bd32cff057 (fetched 2026-11-24). It is a variable font; FreeType and HarfBuzz use its default instance.

notes: Fixed test font for the font library and font backend tests (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.5): tests read the file from the repository and never use fonts installed on the machine. Not shipped in any product.
Arabic coverage for right-to-left full shaping (contextual forms, the lam-alef ligature).
